name: Myanmar
value: Airstrikes killed 14 in Chin, Rakhine 14–17 Nov
summary: Airstrikes killed 14 civilians in Chin and Rakhine on 14–17 Nov, the Arakan Army says; ICJ ruled genocide 19 Nov
state: The Arakan Army said military airstrikes killed at least 14 civilians and injured 28 in Chin and Rakhine states from 14 to 17 Nov, 12 of them in Paletwa on 14 Nov (DVB). On 19 Nov the International Court of Justice ruled 9–6 that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in northern Rakhine (Al Jazeera). Airstrikes remain frequent, but searches on 21 Nov found no major city changing hands and no cross-border escalation, so Watch holds.
for_you: Civilians in Rakhine, Chin and other conflict areas face airstrikes and displacement. The FCDO advises against travel to large parts of Myanmar.
rubric_hit: Watch: civil war at sustained intensity; no major city fallen or cross-border escalation

sources.title: DVB — Airstrikes kill 14 civilians and injure 28 in 4 days across Chin and Rakhine states
Al Jazeera — UN's top court finds Myanmar guilty of genocide against Rohingya

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.

rubric.alert: Major city falls, mass-casualty airstrikes, or cross-border escalation.
